questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The nature and the program, because it's not possible to do in Copenhagen.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: A good experience, with a lot of different ways of teaching. The teaching at the university was very different from the danish way of doing it.

questions.answer: I think it was okay a little bit messy, and a lot of thinks had to be signed. It could have been nice with a guide-document.

questions.answer: pretty easy, because I was able to speak my main language with them
